profile: Mac Companion concrete macOS Interactive platform effects v0.1
rules: construction is inert and neither enumerates capture content nor requests or consumes Control authority
capture starts only for the exact active Desktop descriptor, opaque selected-display mapping, visible indicator, and validated execution lease
ordinary ScreenCaptureKit user consent is sufficient for this beta slice; persistent capture authorization is not claimed or required
input classes require a positive CGPreflightPostEventAccess result before capture installation succeeds and never trigger an implicit permission prompt from remote traffic
the capture profile must exactly match the descriptor dimensions and the selected physical display must still match the opaque menu-owned mapping
ScreenCaptureKit retains at most the newest one unconsumed callback while VideoToolbox owns at most one encoding frame and one newest waiting frame
VideoToolbox output crosses the serialized runtime fence before entering the bounded media queue and the XPC drain awaits one exact acknowledgement before dequeueing another record
input planning, event construction, and posting are serialized under one local owner and state commits only after the complete planned event batch is constructed
display loss, permission loss, capture or encoder failure, media rejection, queue overflow, input construction failure, or post-lifecycle ambiguity terminates the exact Interactive session
cleanup releases every tracked key, modifier, and pointer button before stopping capture, purges queued media, clears retained frame state, and clears the visible indicator
this profile grants no shell, file, clipboard, audio, automation, provider, Accessibility inspection, window metadata, or persistent unattended capture authority
